dz: 在叛军要求他退位而长期围攻后,卡里夫·乌斯曼被刺杀,因为叛军进入了他的宫殿.
de: After a prolonged siege by rebels who demand his abdication, caliph Uthman is assassinated as the rebels enter his palace.

t: 阿里成为 Rashidun 哈里发国的哈里发。
te: Ali becomes Caliph of the Rashidun Caliphate.
